Frequently asked questions

Can I move my schedule over from a spreadsheet?

Yes. Upload the spreadsheet file and classes, teachers and rooms appear in the timetable. Check them once before you share the link with anyone.

How do students pay for classes?

A student pays by card when booking or at the studio, whichever you decide for each class. The money goes to the studio account, not to ours.

What happens if a student does not show up?

You set a cancellation rule: how many hours before the start a place can be freed. After that the place opens for others and the student gets a message.

Do students need a separate app?

No. Students book from a page in the browser and get reminders in a messenger or by email. Nobody has to install anything, neither they nor you.
